changes: Separate activity intents from ordinary reply selection and reject them before generic delivery touches the database or network.
Discover new turns after a persistent activation watermark, plus work already active at startup.
Schedule source-bound activity independently of model and speech processing.
Preserve source binding for resumed parents and child runs.
Use a distinct process ownership lock and a Discord-journal-specific shutdown snapshot.
native_tests_passed: Activity cannot occupy the ordinary reply queue.
Ordinary reply retry deadlines and restart state remain intact.
Completed historical conversations are not backfilled.
Active-at-start and new completed turns are discovered.
Terminal caught-up target sleeps; newer parent revision reactivates it.
Stale settling revision cannot put a resumed parent to sleep.
Child discovery retains its original source.
Journal snapshot records coverage, refuses overwrite, and detects corrupted retained originals.
Gateway-confirmed receipt wins stale HTTP completion and advances exactly once.
HAS_THREAD-only update preserves inference; changed text, attachments, partial updates and deletion invalidate.
retained_failures: Initial worker shutdown incorrectly used the conversation-archive verifier for a Discord journal. It reported failure; the incomplete candidate backup was retained, not advertised as valid. Replaced with journal-specific verification.
Initial new-turn activity discovery briefly ran before model admission and used denial backoff. Changed to awaiting-admission polling.
Gateway confirmed a sent nonce before HTTP completion, returning stale-attempt to sender and causing delay. Authoritative-receipt handling now passes its native regression.

Third addressed turn after restart was cancelled: attaching the thread emitted a full MESSAGE_UPDATE differing only in HAS_THREAD flag and omitted nonce. Added exact semantic metadata-only exemption; actual content/attachments/identity changes still invalidate. Native regression passed; revised agent/activity built and deployed idle. Two subsequent addressed turns completed with channel replies and separate source-attached activity threads.

isolated_process_checks.clean_shutdown_snapshot: passed revised executable, validated journal-specific receipt

production: bounded public-activity stage enabled after idle check; full trace UI still pending

live_multiple_turns.turn_one: Actual checklist call; reply in channel; source-attached activity thread automatically created
live_multiple_turns.turn_two: Correctly recalled preceding marker; separate source-attached thread; reply in channel
live_multiple_turns.receipts: Both original replies sent; five activity messages sent across two distinct original-message threads; both targets caught up and inactive
live_multiple_turns.restart: Original five activity posts preserved without duplicates. Third source attached correctly but reply cancelled by metadata guard; not counted as a passing conversational turn.
live_multiple_turns.after_fix: Two consecutive real addressed turns passed: prior marker recalled after restart, then unrelated arithmetic answered correctly. Both replies in original channel; each thread bound to its original user message.

limitations: Public activity projection does not replace the required restricted full-trace UI.
Speak, slash commands, permission/fault matrix and remaining Phase Two work are not claimed complete.
